mezo.create.lede: Invoice in MUSD, the dollar of the Mezo network, which people mint by borrowing against their bitcoin. Your client pays from their own wallet, *straight to yours*. Creating an invoice costs nothing: no gas, no sign-up, no platform fee.
mezo.create.step3: Your client checks the invoice and pays from their wallet, which pays a small network fee in BTC. The MUSD go straight to you; nothing is held in between.
mezo.pay.billLede: Compare the amount and the address with what the seller told you. When you approve, the MUSD go *straight from your wallet to theirs*. PayLink never holds them.
mezo.pay.openLede: This link has no set price, like a tip jar. Type what you want to send and check the address. The MUSD go *straight from your wallet to theirs*.
mezo.pay.step2: Your wallet asks you to approve the payment, then sends it. It pays the small network fee, in BTC.
mezo.pay.assure: Non-custodial: the MUSD go straight from your wallet to the address above. Your wallet pays the network fee, in BTC.
mezo.pay.thanks: The MUSD are already in the seller's wallet.
mezo.ticket.scanSub: In {symbol}, the Bitcoin-backed dollar, from an EVM wallet on Mezo (MetaMask, Rabby…). The money goes straight to the seller.
mezo.pay.needsBtc: No BTC for the network fee: on Mezo, your wallet pays it.
mezo.pay.waitBtc: Waiting for BTC for the fee
mezo.ledger.cancelNoGas: Cancelling sends one transaction from your wallet: it needs a little {coin} for the network fee.
mezo.wallet.lede: Wallets installed in this browser. PayLink never sees your keys: your wallet shows you everything before you approve. Use an EVM wallet such as MetaMask: Bitcoin wallets that need Mezo Passport cannot connect here yet.
mezo.wallet.none: No wallet found in this browser. On a phone, open this page in your wallet's own browser (MetaMask, Rabby…). On a computer, install a wallet extension, then reload. Bitcoin wallets that need Mezo Passport cannot connect here yet.
mezo.notes.title: MUSD and BTC on Mezo
mezo.notes.musdText: is the dollar of the Mezo network. People mint it by borrowing against bitcoin they lock as collateral, worth at least 110% of the loan. PayLink moves it from wallet to wallet and never holds it.
mezo.notes.feeText: Signing an invoice sends nothing, so it is free. Paying takes one transaction from the payer's wallet (two for some smart accounts: approve, then pay), and its fee is paid in BTC, Mezo's gas coin: a tiny amount, but the wallet needs some.
mezo.notes.gaslessText: Elsewhere PayLink can pay the fee for your client, with dollars that accept signed transfers (EIP-3009). MUSD accepts permits (EIP-2612) instead, so the payer's own wallet sends the payment.
mezo.notes.issuerText: On Mezo testnet, the owner of the MUSD contract can allow chosen addresses to mint MUSD, or to burn it from any account. That power is the issuer's, not PayLink's.
mezo.test.title: Test MUSD, step by step
mezo.test.btcText: From the Mezo faucet, behind a captcha, or by asking in the #testnet channel of Mezo's Discord.
mezo.test.borrowText: MUSD has no faucet: you borrow it against your test BTC in Mezo's testnet app. The smallest loan is 1,800 MUSD, and Mezo adds a 200 MUSD reserve and a 0.1% fee to the debt: plan on about 0.04 test BTC of collateral.
mezo.test.payText: Send MUSD to your test payers with a plain transfer, and a little test BTC for their fees. Then share your link: each payer opens it and pays.
mezo.funds.musd: MUSD has no faucet: borrow it against test BTC in Mezo's testnet app, or ask someone who holds some to send it.
mezo.funds.btc: The network fee is paid in BTC, and this wallet holds none. Get test BTC from the Mezo faucet, then check again.
mezo.fee.line: Network fee: about {sats} sat, paid in BTC by your wallet.
mezo.fee.basis: An upper estimate: the gas limit PayLink sets for this payment times the network's current gas price. Your wallet shows the exact fee before you approve.
mezo.status.tokenOk: {name} ({symbol}), {decimals} decimals · permit (EIP-2612): yes · signed transfers (EIP-3009): no, as the registry says.
mezo.status.tokenErr: The token on the network does not match the registry.
mezo.status.feeValue: Paid in BTC by the payer: about {sats} sat per payment at the current gas price.
mezo.status.gaslessValue: Not on Mezo: MUSD has no signed transfers (EIP-3009), so each payer's wallet sends the payment.
mezo.status.relayerNone: Does not serve Mezo testnet: each payer's wallet sends the payment.
mezo.borrow.line: Or borrow MUSD without selling bitcoin: Mezo's smallest loan that covers this is {loan} MUSD. It needs at least {btc} test BTC locked as collateral: {ratio}% of the {debt} MUSD debt, at {price} USD per BTC on Mezo's price feed, read now. Lock more to stay clear of liquidation.
mezo.status.loanValue: Smallest loan {loan} MUSD: at least {btc} test BTC of collateral ({ratio}% of a {debt} MUSD debt), at {price} USD per BTC on Mezo's price feed.
mezo.pay.unconfirmed: Your payment was sent ({tx}), but {network} has not returned it yet. Check it again before you pay again: nothing new is signed or sent.
mezo.check.title: Was I really paid?
mezo.check.lede: Paste what your client sent: their message, the text of a screenshot, a transaction hash, a PayLink link or receipt link. The answer comes from Mezo testnet alone, never from the message: a screenshot or an “I paid” proves nothing until the chain shows the payment.
mezo.check.label: What your client sent
mezo.check.hint: The message stays on this device: only the hashes and links in it are looked up on Mezo testnet.
mezo.check.connect: Connect the wallet you get paid to: each payment is compared with your address.
mezo.check.paid: Mezo testnet shows this payment, to your address.
mezo.check.notReceived: Mezo testnet shows no payment to you for what this message names. Do not deliver on the strength of the message.
mezo.check.pending: The transaction is waiting for a block: it is not money received yet. Check again in a minute.
mezo.check.unavailable: Mezo testnet did not answer, so nothing is decided. Check again in a moment; until then, treat it as not received.
mezo.check.nothing: This message names nothing the chain can check: no transaction hash, no PayLink link, no amount of one of your invoices on this device. Ask your client for the transaction hash or their receipt link.
mezo.check.toYou: Paid to your address, the invoice's payee.
mezo.check.byAmount: Found by its amount alone: the message names no hash and no link.
mezo.check.mismatch: The message says {claimed}; the amount above is what the chain shows. Trust the chain.
mezo.check.foreign: A PayLink link in this message is on {host}, not on this site. Never connect a wallet or sign anything there.
mezo.check.find.otherPayee: {ref}: a payment, but to {payee}, not to you.
mezo.check.find.otherInvoice: {ref}: a payment to you, but for another invoice ({invoice}) than the one in the message. An old receipt is not a new payment.
mezo.check.find.noTx: {ref}: Mezo testnet has no such transaction, after asking again for about 11 seconds. Made up, mistyped, or from another network.
mezo.check.find.pending: {ref}: sent, not in a block yet.
mezo.check.find.reverted: {ref}: the transaction failed on Mezo testnet; no money moved.
mezo.check.find.notPaylink: {ref}: this transaction is not a PayLink payment (no payment event from the PayLink contract).
mezo.check.find.forged: {ref}: this receipt link does not match the chain. {why}
mezo.check.find.badLink: A link on {host} is not a valid Mezo testnet PayLink link: altered, cut, or for another network.
mezo.paste.title: Paste the client's message
mezo.paste.label: Client's message
mezo.paste.hint: Fills the amount and how long the link stays valid from what the message says, by fixed rules: no AI reads it, and nothing leaves this device. Check every field before you sign.
mezo.paste.unsupported: The message asks {said}: this terminal invoices MUSD only. Convert it yourself; the amount was not filled.
mezo.paste.noAmount: No amount in MUSD or dollars found: type it yourself.
mezo.paste.due: Due {date}: the link stays valid {validity}, the shortest choice that covers it.
mezo.paste.dueLate: Due {date}: more than 30 days away, so the link's validity was left as it is.
mezo.paste.duePast: The date {date} has passed: the link's validity was left as it is.
mezo.paste.noDue: No due date found: the link's validity was left as it is.
